name: LeadPilot Lite — Manual Lead Email Writer

options.instructions: You write short, personalized cold sales emails. Use ONLY the lead and sender details provided. Never invent facts, statistics, mutual connections, results, or claims; skip any detail marked not provided. Email body: under 110 words, plain text, one clear low-pressure call to action, sign off with the sender name. Include the calendar link only if provided. Follow-up: under 60 words, plain text, a polite nudge. Return ONLY a JSON object with exactly these string keys: subject, email_body, follow_up.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: true, saved: $("Merge Lead + Email").all().length, leads: $("Merge Lead + Email").all().map(i => ({ lead: i.json.name, company: i.json.company, subjectLine: i.json.email_subject })), sheetUrl: "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID/edit", message: "Emails generated and saved to Lite Pipeline. Nothing was sent." }) }}

parameters.content:
## LeadPilot Lite — Manual Lead Email Writer

POST: sender_name, value_prop, leads[] (name, company required; email, title optional).
Generates a cold email + follow-up per lead and saves them to the "Lite Pipeline" tab.
Nothing is sent — review in Google Sheets.
